name: Structure Relations Dev Environment
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libnspr4 libnss3 libdbus-1-3 && mkdir -p .vscode && cp -f .devcontainer/settings.json .vscode/settings.json && cp -f .devcontainer/tasks.json .vscode/tasks.json && cp -f .devcontainer/launch.json .vscode/launch.json && cp -f .devcontainer/DevCont.env .env && cp -f .devcontainer/StructureRelations.yml environment.yml && conda init && conda env create --name StructureRelations -f .devcontainer/StructureRelations.yml
